content.text:
Use Tailwind's arbitrary value syntax for `border-color`:

```html
<div id="test" class="border-[rgb(var(--foreground-rgb))]">
```

Since `--foreground-rgb` holds raw RGB channel numbers (not a full color), you need the full `rgb(var(--foreground-rgb))` expression inside brackets — the shorthand `border-(--foreground-rgb)` only works when the variable *is* a complete color value.

**Source:** `tailwind-css/src/docs/adding-custom-styles.mdx` (arbitrary values / CSS variable shorthand section, ~line 73-83) and `tailwind-css/src/docs/border-color.mdx` for the `border-*` utility syntax.
